changes.title: Custom combat effects
changes.text: Implemented maximum-health, accuracy and evasion gameplay factors from the locked custom configuration; player controls and the remaining modifiers are still in development.

changes.title: Combat slider regressions
changes.text: Added finite-skill, zero-evasion, protected-skill, six-class health and save/load checks for the custom combat factors.

changes.title: Verification records
changes.text: Recorded TEST113's successful build/emulator evidence and the remaining custom-slider work.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I added the first five custom gameplay factors and preserved original scoring. The remaining sliders and native controls still need implementation and verification.
